BiblicalUsage: Hamath-zobah is named once, as a city Solomon went up against and prevailed over, in the account of his building and his borders. The name joins two places into one: Hamath, the great northern city, and Zobah, the Aramean kingdom beside it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a single-verse town matters, because it marks how far the kingdom God promised actually reached under Solomon.
